2. Scope of Work Executed
Bridges Flyovers works for Jal Nigam, Gujarat completed 2025.
The work was carried out under site conditions that included hard rock encountered below the founding
level over part of the alignment. The agency organised its resources around this without recourse to the
department for additional assistance, and the programme was re-sequenced locally to keep the critical path
intact.
An extension of time was granted during execution on account of diversion of a live utility main discovered
during excavation. The delay was examined by this office and held to be beyond the agency's control; no
compensation was claimed and none has been paid.
The above work was executed under the supervision of the undersigned in accordance with the approved
drawings, specifications, and the terms and conditions of the contract. The work has been completed in all
respects and has been got inspected by the Engineer-in-Chief / Superintending Engineer.
DOC-CC-071

3. Quality Assessment
The overall quality of the completed work is graded Very Good. Workmanship was consistently within
tolerance, and final inspection was completed in the presence of the client's representative. Materials were
drawn from approved sources and the test results filed with this office were within the limits prescribed in
the contract specification.

5. Deficiency / Observation List
At the time of taking over, minor honeycombing on one abutment face, since made good. Regarding site
safety, no lost-time injury was reported over the contract period. The agency's conduct during the contract
is recorded as prompt and well documented.
Nil. No major deficiencies observed during the final inspection carried out on 2025-02-20. All minor
observations pointed out during the interim inspections have been rectified to the satisfaction of the
inspecting authority.
6. Recommendation
Having satisfied myself as to the quantity and quality of the work executed, and on the basis of the joint
measurements recorded in the measurement book, I certify the work complete and recommend release of
the balance payment together with the retention money due on expiry of the defect liability period.
Certified by S. Sethi, Project Director.
The agency attended to all observations raised during execution and the work was taken over on satisfactory
completion of the final inspection.
This certificate is issued for the sole purpose of recording completion of the above work and does not absolve the contractor of any
obligations under the contract, including the defect liability period.
